title: Hotel Management Web Application
owner_request: Create a small hotel operations application for reception and management workflows. The system must support rooms, guests, reservations, reservation status changes, and a concise operational overview through a Vue frontend and a Node.js Express API. Persistence may use a deterministic repository fixture for the formal case so the evaluation focuses on workflow completeness, traceability, execution, tests, repair, and User Twin feedback.
constraints: Use JavaScript across browser and server application code
Use Vue for the browser application
Use Node.js and Express for the API
Keep authentication local, simulated, or fixture-backed for the formal case
Do not require a paid external service
network_policy: Dependency installation may use the approved Web runner policy; build, test, and generated application runtime must not depend on an external production service.
operator_instructions: Create the project through the normal OrchesTwin greenfield workflow.
Resolve every owner gate through the OrchesTwin UI or API without bypassing the governed transition.
Preserve generated source, deterministic execution evidence, synthetic User Twin findings, traceability, and final export evidence.
